capabilities: : Update metadata via dashboard dropdown menus
: Filter notes by status or priority
: Integrate metadata commands into the Command Palette
disambiguation: Not a note navigation tool; it focuses on managing workflow metadata like status and priority.
extras: Operates entirely locally and offline within your Obsidian vault.
problem: Users need a centralized way to track, filter, and update the workflow status and priority of notes defined in their frontmatter without manually editing individual files.
summary: Status Pilot manages note workflow metadata, including status, priority, and level, by scanning YAML frontmatter and providing a dedicated dashboard for organization.
